title: George Lewis away at the start, Sales as bandleader, and the quartets
summary: George left town as the hall began, declined to lead, and played as sideman; Sales became leader of the band, and the quartet with Jim and others is recalled.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
